title: S2: migrate rate types with booking-price compatibility

input.requestedOutcome: Migrate Rate Type loading and writes to operation-backend without changing the legacy shape used by booking quote functions.
acceptanceCriteria: Use documented rate-type endpoints and map API detail to legacy booking-compatible fields.
Use server-first operations-mode mutations and leave legacy mode unchanged.
Keep net as the booking charge tier and preserve route validity, tiers, bundles, charter, longtail, and transfer data.
No backend, database, schema, migration, or mapping changes.
constraints: Work only in D:/projects/wt-ops-rate-types on agent/ops-rate-types.
Use laOps/laOpsFetch plumbing; no direct operation-backend fetch.
Preserve classic script order and legacy behavior.
assumptions: 00-ops-core.js is loaded before the S2 adapter.
Backend contracts in src/routes/operations.ts and src/domain/rate-types.ts are authoritative.

output.summary: Added an ops-only Rate Type adapter that loads API details into the legacy camelCase projection and performs server-first create/edit/delete operations.

filesChanged.purpose: Loads the S2 adapter after ops core/adapters and before ops boot.
Maps rate-type API contracts, loads authoritative details, wraps legacy UI writes, and preserves booking net-price compatibility.
Checks API-to-legacy projection and legacy-to-API price round-trip behavior.
Durable task report and verification evidence.

behaviorChanges.before: Local seed/blob rate types were available to the page.
behaviorChanges.after: Authenticated operation-backend list/detail responses replace the projection; failed loads clear it and disable writes.
POST/PATCH/PUT/DELETE API calls complete before the in-memory projection is replaced; failures surface through laOps.

behaviorChanges.before: Booking readers consumed legacy seatRates directly.
behaviorChanges.after: API net cells populate seatRates; sell/min_sell stay separate in priceTiers.

changed: ops-mode wrappers for rtOpenNew, rtOpenEdit, rtSaveDraft, rtPersist, rtAddonTypesOpen, rtDeleteRT

details: Legacy mode still delegates to original rtPersist and rt* functions.
Custom add-on pricing is refused in S2 rather than sent or silently discarded.

verification.evidence: Shared file syntax check exited 0; file was not modified.
Cannot resolve package playwright in the frontend worktree.

decisions: Fetch list summaries and then every detail so booking quote consumers receive all route prices.
Refuse unsupported custom add-on pricing visibly because S4 owns that catalogue and the S2 API contract has no field for it.
Refetch the server detail after multi-call edits before replacing local state.
risks: Existing edits use multiple documented route-block calls; a later refusal can leave a server-side partial mutation, after which the adapter refetches the authoritative record.
Authenticated browser integration coverage remains pending the missing Playwright dependency.
blockers: Frontend ops UI test is blocked because playwright is not installed in D:/projects/wt-ops-rate-types; install dependencies and rerun npm run test:ops.
followUps: Run authenticated browser integration test after installing Playwright.
rollback: Revert the local commit or remove the S2 tag/adapter; no database rollback is needed.
exclusions_honored: No backend or DB files changed.
No shared 08-app.js, 90-ops-boot.js, or booking renderer changes.
